capabilities: Look up words in a local ECDICT dictionary with optional Youdao enrichment
Create and refresh structured vocabulary notes from editable Markdown templates
Preview and add virtual or real WikiLinks for known vocabulary words
Synchronize Eudic wordbooks with matching local subfolders
Export vocabulary notes one-way to Anki through AnkiConnect
extras: Listed as a beta plugin installed via BRAT and not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Dictionary data is stored in IndexedDB outside the vault; the Eudic token is stored as plain text in the plugin's data.json. No telemetry; offline lookup needs no account or key, and Youdao/Eudic/Anki features stay inactive until configured.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in dictionary or vocabulary-note workflow, so language learners must keep definitions in separate apps and maintain word notes by hand.

relations.evidence: LexiBridge downloads ecdict.csv from skywind3000/ECDICT, converts it locally, and imports the entries into IndexedDB.
Optionally enrich one word at a time with Youdao.
Optionally synchronize selected Eudic wordbooks with matching local subfolders.
Optionally send vocabulary notes one way to Anki through AnkiConnect.

requires.name: Anki Desktop with AnkiConnect (for Anki export)
Eudic Open API token (for wordbook sync)

summary: Local-first English-Chinese dictionary toolkit that looks up words, builds vocabulary notes, links them in text, syncs Eudic wordbooks, and exports to Anki.
